categories.main_business_segments: OCI Company Ltd. operates primarily in two business segments: Basic Chemicals and Carbon Chemicals. The Basic Chemicals segment includes products such as polysilicon, phosphoric acid, hydrogen peroxide, hexachlorodisilane, and chlor-alkali, mainly serving semiconductor and secondary battery materials markets. The Carbon Chemicals segment produces carbon black, pitch, BTX (benzene, toluene, xylene), plasticizers, and anhydrous phthalic acid, with major customers in the automotive tire industry. Additionally, the company has a minor energy solutions segment focused on solar power generation.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced chemical processing technologies including refining of metal silicon to produce ultra-high purity polysilicon (11-Nine grade) for semiconductors. It employs specialized purification and synthesis processes for high-purity phosphoric acid and hydrogen peroxide used in semiconductor manufacturing. Carbon black production involves incomplete combustion of hydrocarbon feedstocks, while pitch is derived from distillation of coal tar residues. The company also engages in electrolysis for chlor-alkali production and is developing silicon hydride (SiH4) production for next-generation battery anode materials.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include semiconductor wafer manufacturers such as SK Siltron, and major automotive tire companies like Hankook Tire and Nexen Tire. The Basic Chemicals segment serves semiconductor, display, and secondary battery industries, while the Carbon Chemicals segment caters to rubber reinforcement, aluminum smelting, and chemical intermediates markets. The company also supplies specialty materials to battery anode producers like Nexeon and engages in long-term supply contracts with global solar cell manufacturers.
categories.geographic_coverage: OCI operates primarily in South Korea with production facilities in Gunsan, Iksan, Pohang, and Gwangyang. It has significant export sales to Asia, Europe, China, and the United States. The company is expanding its manufacturing footprint internationally through a joint venture in Malaysia for polysilicon production and holds subsidiaries in China and Japan. Its sales are approximately 65% domestic and 35% international.
categories.supply_chain_position: OCI operates mainly in the upstream and midstream segments of the chemical supply chain, producing raw and intermediate chemical materials such as polysilicon, hydrogen peroxide, and carbon black. These products serve as essential inputs for downstream manufacturers in semiconductor wafer fabrication, battery component production, and tire manufacturing. The company also engages in some downstream activities through energy solutions and specialty chemical product sales.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in high-purity semiconductor materials and next-generation battery materials, including silicon hydride for silicon anodes. It maintains a central research institute focused on enhancing product value, environmental sustainability, and expanding into energy sectors. Strategic initiatives include joint ventures for polysilicon production, long-term supply contracts with battery material producers, and development of specialty carbon materials. OCI invests in environmental management technologies and safety systems as part of its sustainable growth strategy.
categories.revenue_model: OCI generates revenue primarily through the manufacturing and direct sales of chemical products, including polysilicon, carbon black, and related specialty chemicals. Revenue streams include product sales (approximately 76%), trading of goods (19%), and service income such as utilities and asset leasing (minor portion). The company secures long-term supply contracts with key customers to stabilize revenue and engages in export sales under various trade terms including letters of credit.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: OCI holds a leading market position domestically as the sole producer of ultra-high purity polysilicon (11-Nine grade) and the largest carbon black manufacturer in South Korea. It competes globally with chemical companies specializing in semiconductor materials and carbon chemicals. The company leverages its technological expertise and stable supply relationships to maintain competitive advantages against international chemical producers and emerging market entrants.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: Established as a spin-off in May 2023, OCI reported revenues of approximately 1.29 trillion KRW and operating profit of 57.45 billion KRW for the partial fiscal year ending December 2023. Total assets stand near 1.99 trillion KRW with a capital adequacy ratio of about 49.4%. The company has demonstrated stable profitability despite global economic challenges and is pursuing growth through strategic investments and joint ventures in semiconductor and battery material sectors.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: OCI emphasizes its unique capability to produce ultra-high purity polysilicon critical for semiconductor wafer manufacturing, positioning itself as a key domestic supplier with proprietary technology. Its carbon black production system is flexible to use multiple feedstocks, minimizing raw material risk and ensuring stable supply. The company focuses on high-value specialty chemicals, long-term customer partnerships, and expanding into emerging markets like silicon anode materials for batteries, differentiating through technological innovation and sustainability commitments.
